purpose: Content-addressed binding of all frozen pre-execution artifacts for INSA-ID-E1 v2 revision. SHA-256 locks every file; git blob SHA-1 provides cross-reference into frozen git history. No artifact may be modified after this manifest freezes; any material deviation triggers STOP per proposal v4 §8.

audit_trail.v1_defects_summary: See experiments/2026-09-11-insa-id-e1/audit/AUDIT_TRAIL.md for the complete list of v1 defects and their v2 corrections.

insa_frozen_architecture_reference.binding_description: The INSA v0.3 architecture source is bound by git blob SHA-1 (the immutable identity handle in git history). The v0.3 file is at d2c2ad9 INSA-ARCHITECTURE-v0.3-candidate.md and is not modified by INSA-ID-E1. Verification command: git cat-file -p 848e0fe014f5b4a61ba2cb92e772ee3499dca9c1

proposal_binding.binding_description: proposal_commit_sha is the Git commit SHA (40 hex); proposal_file_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the proposal file bytes at that commit (64 hex). The approval message from Frank referenced an earlier commit on the same branch; the current proposal state is at the HEAD commit recorded here. Verification command: git show <commit_sha>:docs/proposals/2026-09-10-INSA-ID-E1-proposal.md | sha256sum

v0_1_protocol_reference.relationship_to_INSA_ID_E1: Referenced for v0.1 §11.2 (BIB 4-dim preservation criterion), §11.3 (8 C12 axes), §11.4 (inter-evaluator agreement), §14 (stop rules), §15 (statistical interpretation). NOT modified by INSA-ID-E1; INSA-ID-E1 inherits specific sections verbatim.

bib_frozen_source_reference.binding_description: On-disk SHA-256 must match the value in this manifest. The git blob SHA-1 (from c3692150) is the historical identity handle that proves the file content is byte-identical to the frozen BIB source. Verification command: git show c3692150:<source-path> | sha256sum

B.inherits_from: dbi-evolution-v0.1 frozen protocol §11.1 (85-observation BIB non-deviated envelope)

covers: subset-(a) BIB 4-dim Manhattan tolerances (G_pres_a +1.5, G_pres_b 2.5 abs)

Dynamic fields (auth token SHA, telegram message ID, GO timestamps, session/m_commit timestamps, draw_event_sha256, execution_order_list_sha256) explicitly listed as NOT IN this manifest.
Execution-authority witness schema referenced from protocol/EXECUTION-ORDER.md §6.
authority_manifest_summary.INV_AUTH_5_freshness_protocol: per-candidate freshness witness at M-commit boundary

preservation_model_binding.subset_a_role: calibrated BIB 4-dim behavior vector, primary identity metric (inherited from v0.1 §11.2)
preservation_model_binding.subset_b_role: 8 C12 non-target preservation axes (inherited from v0.1 §11.3)
preservation_model_binding.non_collapse_check_command_v2: python3 -c "import json; a=set(d['id'] for d in json.load(open('inputs/preservation-dimensions-subset-a.json'))['dimensions']); b=set(d['id'] for d in json.load(open('inputs/preservation-dimensions-subset-b.json'))['axes']); inter = a & b; assert inter == set(), f'set_intersection must be empty; got {inter}'; print('PASS: subset-(a) IDs and subset-(b) IDs are disjoint')"
preservation_model_binding.non_collapse_check_expected_v2: intersection == empty_set() (subset-(a) IDs BIB-4D-1..4 disjoint from subset-(b) IDs C12-1..8)
preservation_model_binding.non_collapse_check_actual_v2: <filled at freeze time; if intersection is non-empty, STOP and escalate>

evaluator_a.role: M and G scoring (independent of evaluator B)

evaluator_b.substrate: Claude Code CLI, fresh session per I-AUTH-05
evaluator_b.role: M and G scoring (independent of evaluator A)

blinding_discipline.v2_separation: v2 separates per-candidate scoring (evaluator-side) from aggregate computation (analysis-side, post-lock). Evaluators return per-candidate raw scores only; no G_pres_*, no G_mod_*, no C12 BROKEN.

frozen_scoring_algorithm.algorithm: HMAC-SHA256(draw_event_key, per-tuple-salt)[:8] as little-endian uint64; sort ascending; lex tie-break (R, B, arm, candidate). Per-tuple salt = sha256('INSA-ID-E1:' + R + ':' + B + ':' + arm + ':' + candidate).
frozen_scoring_algorithm.reproducibility: Same seed file -> identical output SHA; different seed file -> different output. Zero operator discretion after GO (script takes only seed-file path and output path).

frozen_reconstruction_input_builder.algorithm: For each (R, B, arm): concatenate reconstruction-prompt + identity-contract + (M-directive or C-directive). 6 output files, byte-identical for each (R, B, arm) tuple.

execution_order_binding.draw_event_capture: OS-CSPRNG at preflight time: draw_event_key = sha256(utc_timestamp || os.urandom(32)).digest() (32 bytes). Seed file written to hashing/execution-order-seed.bin (mode 0444). draw_event_sha256 = sha256(draw_event_key).hexdigest() recorded in execution-authority-witness.json.

phases_v2.phase_0: Pre-dispatch preflight (static only; no model invocation). C20 NOT in Phase 0.
phases_v2.phase_1: Generation (per (R, B, arm, candidate) in locked order).
phases_v2.phase_2: Arm-C scoring + C20 control-validity gate. C20 FAIL -> STOP, INVALID_EXPERIMENT. C20 PASS -> proceed.
phases_v2.phase_4: Substantive analysis (joint, not ordered ELSE IF) per proposal v4 §5.4 STEP 3.

stop_conditions_inherited.C20_definition: Arm-C per-(R, B) BIB 4-dim mean Manhattan distance from historical BIB mean, within envelope -> PASS. +1.5 tolerance does NOT apply to C20 (per v0.1 §11.2 PI freeze correction 1, C-1). C20 FAIL -> INVALID_EXPERIMENT.
v0_1_5_stop_rules: Material deviation during generation -> STOP unless PI separately adjudicates
Evaluator substitution after observing candidates -> forbidden
Decision tree semantics change -> forbidden (§5.4 must remain joint, not ordered ELSE IF)
stop_conditions_inherited.v0_3_T1_T2_T3: Runtime failure systematic thresholds (proposal v4 §5.5.2): T1 >=50% same-class; T2 arm-imbalance (fail_M/max(fail_C,1)>=2 AND fail_M-fail_C>=3 AND fail_M+fail_C>=5); T3 substrate-wide unavailability

evidence_chain_summary.evidence_profile: per-step evidence capture per proposal v4 §14; per-candidate evidence file runs/<R>/<B>/<arm>/evidence-<N>.json; locked evaluator scorebooks evaluation/evaluator-A-scorebook.json + evaluation/evaluator-B-scorebook.json; synthesis results/score-independent.md + results/analysis.md + results/disposition.md + results/unblinded-analysis-results.json + results/de-blinding-table.json
evidence_chain_summary.manifest_role: MANIFEST.json itself is part of the evidence chain: it content-addresses every pre-execution artifact and the v0.3 + v0.1 references, providing the cross-cut index that the evidence chain is anchored to.

four_gates_modification_success_v2.G_mod_a: For each evaluator independently: mean(modification_conformance for all Arm-M candidates) >= 3.5
four_gates_modification_success_v2.G_mod_b: For each evaluator independently: count(candidate_all_pass==True for all Arm-M candidates) / count(total Arm-M candidates) >= 0.80
four_gates_modification_success_v2.G_mod_c: For each evaluator independently: AND over R in {R1, R2, R3}: count(candidate_all_pass==True for Arm-M candidates in R) / count(total Arm-M candidates in R) >= 0.70
four_gates_modification_success_v2.G_mod_d: For each evaluator independently: arm_M_all_pass_rate - arm_C_all_pass_rate >= 0.50
four_gates_modification_success_v2.Modification_Success_per_evaluator: G_mod_a AND G_mod_b AND G_mod_c AND G_mod_d

c12_broken_rule_v2.definition_per_evaluator_e_and_axis_a: axis_a is BROKEN for evaluator_e IF AND ONLY IF BOTH arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a >= 0.30 AND (arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a - arm_C_failure_rate_on_axis_a) >= 0.30
c12_broken_rule_v2.subset_b_pass_per_evaluator: subset-(b) gate PASSES for evaluator_e IF AND ONLY IF no axis in {C12-1..C12-8} is BROKEN for evaluator_e
c12_broken_rule_v2.Non_target_Identity_Preservation_per_eva: (G_pres_subset_a_a AND G_pres_subset_a_b) AND (no C12-axis-BROKEN for evaluator_e)
